content.content: 1. Necessity: the argument refusal needs the two read verbs' surfaces for the surfaces it refines — without them, refusing an argument is motiveless. Fail if an edge can be dropped without loss. 2. License: no element of the elaboration contradicts a prerequisite. Fail on any contradicting element — name the element.
content.rationale: Log's and validate's argument surfaces are where the elaboration meets the read verbs; the gate keeps the use sound without testing refusal itself.
